question: Should maintainers land this protected Codex generated-image delivery PR after the remaining CI completes, or require additional visible Telegram proof first?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and proof-positive, but it carries a protected label and intentionally changes the media-delivery behavior that users see in channels.

options.title: Land After CI
options.body: Accept the remaining message-delivery risk once the exact-head CI finishes and a maintainer is satisfied with the focused tests and live output proof.

options.title: Ask For Telegram Proof
options.body: Request a short Telegram Desktop proof showing exactly one generated-image attachment with no media warning before merge.

options.title: Pause For Compatibility Review
options.body: Hold the PR only if maintainers want to preserve savedPath-only typed delivery for older or custom app-server deployments.

recommendation.title: Land After CI
recommendation.body: Accept the remaining message-delivery risk once the exact-head CI finishes and a maintainer is satisfied with the focused tests and live output proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior merged ownership on native image delivery and is one of the requested reviewers for this protected PR.
